The '''''Nashtah Pup''''' was a modified [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] as a [[Scout ship/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. It was carried aboard the hunter's primary vessel, the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] in a modified cargo bay. It could carry only two people and had limited life support capabilities.
